messages.text: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

### Chain map
The supported chain is: Wireless Communication requirement → measurable conformance/performance parameter → required Signal Generator and/or Signal Analyzer capability, within 3GPP cellular, NTN, and SAN contexts covered by the passages [100][83][71][79].
| Wireless Communication market / test requirement | Measurable parameter / test item | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| EMC and regulatory testing for wireless devices with 3GPP cellular technology maps to NR base-station RF conformance testing covering Tx, Rx, and performance requirements [100][83]. | Chapter 6 Tx measurements include output power, output power dynamics, transmit ON/OFF power, frequency error, modulation quality, time alignment error, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, SEM, spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation [72]. | Transmitter intermodulation requires an additional signal generator, and the R&S setup lists SMW Base Unit with SMW-K144 for test case 6.7 [72][85]. | The R&S setup lists FSW Base Unit with FSW-K144 for output power, frequency error, modulation quality, time alignment error, ACLR, and SEM, and FSW spectrum analyzer mode for occupied bandwidth and transmitter spurious emissions [85]. |
| 5G NTN-NR extended coverage and NTN-IoT global reach create a need to emulate satellite-channel impairments and weak-link conditions [71]. | NTN testing needs include new fading profiles, atmospheric fading, weather-specific effects, high free-space path loss, low UE-side SNR, minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB, and minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm [19]. | R&S SMW200A channel emulation for NTN testing includes long path delays, enhanced Doppler capabilities, and customized dynamic fading [2]. | NTN component testing uses R&S FSW with frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz, and LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM, and vector signal analysis software [63]. |
| NTN end-to-end system testing requires RF satellite link emulation across UE, NTN payload, service-link channel emulator, and feeder-link channel emulator [16]. | The E2E channel-emulation parameters are update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss [45]. | R&S SMW200A with firmware ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15, and SMW-K820 supports satellite trajectory modeling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [16]. | The cited E2E passages specify signal-generator/channel-emulator capabilities but do not identify a signal-analyzer capability for this E2E chain [16][45]. |
| 5G NR SAN conformance testing targets Satellite Access Node testing linked to 3GPP TS 38.108 and TS 38.181 [79][80]. | SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter characteristics require a spectrum analyzer, while Chapter 7/8 and Chapter 10/11 cover receiver and performance characteristics; SAN TMs/FRCs include output power, radiated transmit power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, OBUE, spurious emissions, EVM, frequency error, receiver sensitivity, and ACS [27][78]. | R&S SMW200A SAN testing features include FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, NR options K144/K148/K171, and B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation [81]. | 5G NR options on R&S FSW / R&S FSVA3000 support SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements [27]. |
| SAN testing needs up to 160 MHz or 200 MHz map to bandwidth, delay, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO [81]. | The supported SAN solution configurations are up to 160 MHz with SMW B10/B14 and up to 200 MHz with SMW B9/B15, both supporting delay requirements and residual Doppler requirements for LEO [81]. | SMW B10/B14 is stated for testing needs up to 160 MHz, and SMW B9/B15 is recommended for testing needs up to 200 MHz [81]. | For the transmitter-measurement side of SAN testing, the supported analyzer role remains FSW / FSVA3000 5G NR options for Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements [27]. |
### Limits
Formal pass/fail limits, measurement uncertainty, test tolerances, instrument options, and software licenses must be checked in the corresponding standards and instrument documents because the cited pages do not provide complete official limits or configurations [6][22][64].

passages.text:
3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 重點摘要
此來源是由 `3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown；封面標示 `1GP` 與 `12-2025`，末頁標示 `Last updated: 08/25`，其中 slide 27 另標示 `2025-09-29 Nokia Workshop at R&S - SigGen Product Update`。本頁以來源原文呈現的 2025 年簡報語境處理，不自行推論正式發布日。

簡報主題是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 針對 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 的 signal generator / channel emulation 測試方案，涵蓋：

- [[5G NTN-NR]] 的 Release 17 / 18 / 19 演進與頻段。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）conformance testing。
- [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 component testing、SAN testing、end-to-end system testing 與 UE testing 分層。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 channel emulator / signal generator 的 NTN 測試能力。
- [[R&S FSW]] 與 [[R&S FSVA3000]] 在 component testing / SAN transmitter measurement 中的角色。
- [[R&S Space Nexus]] 依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files 的待請求 PC software 線索。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 5G NTN-NR 市場與技術背景

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 關鍵實體與概念

- [[NTN signal generator solutions]]：本來源的 solution-level 概念節點。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源最明確的 3GPP conformance testing 應用。
- [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]：本來源對 SMW200A + K820 / Space Nexus 的 E2E satellite RF link emulation 說法。
- [[3GPP TS 38.108]]、[[3GPP TS 38.181]]、[[3GPP TS 36.108]]、[[3GPP TS 36.181]]、[[3GPP TR 38.821]]、[[3GPP TR 38.863]]。

EVM › unresolved
- EVM 的完整公式、filtering、averaging、reference waveform 產生方式與 test equipment uncertainty 未由 [[WIC Glossary]] 提供。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只摘錄 selected 3GPP conformance limits；完整 tables 需回查 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]]。
- [[FWA CPE]] 中 FR2 EVM 的標準依據與測試條件未標示。

EVM › 與既有測試脈絡的關係
- [[FWA CPE]] 與 [[FWA CPE 測試與驗證]] 中的戶外高階 mmWave ODU DVT 項目列出 FR2 EVM，但來源未提供 EVM limit、測試配置或標準章節。
- [[Small Cell BTS 測試資料清單]] 保存 base station Tx / Rx / OTA tests 檔名，但附件未擷取，因此不能補充 EVM 測項。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 補入的是 NR-FR1 SA UE pre-conformance EVM PUCCH/PUSCH 脈絡，不等同 FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、base station 或 production-line EVM limits。

EVM › 使用限制
- 本頁不是完整 EVM measurement tutorial，也不是 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 標準全文。
- [[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開；[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只提供 selected NR-FR1 SA test case 摘要。
- 不可由此頁推論 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、NR 或 production line test 的所有 EVM limits。
- 任何正式 pass / fail limit 應回查對應標準、儀器文件、software version 與 test condition。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A › Digital standards、R&S WinIQSIM2、Pulse Sequencer、MIMO 與 fading
- Internal digital modulation systems 至少需安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10` 或 `R&S®SMW-B9`。
- 來源列出 cellular、wireless connectivity、navigation、broadcast 與 other standards options；包含 `GSM/EDGE`、`3GPP FDD`、`LTE Release 8` 到 `Release 15`、`Cellular IoT`、`5G New Radio`、`5G NR Release 16/17`、`IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`Bluetooth EDR/5.x/5.4`、`GNSS`、`DVB-S2/S2X`、`DVB-RCS2`、`LoRa`、`HRP UWB` 等。
- 來源描述 digital standards 不需要 separate PC software；但 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] 另明列 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。判斷：前者指 instrument internal digital standards，後者指 WinIQSIM2 workflow，不合併為單一規則。
- `R&S®SMW-K144`：5G New Radio，Order No. `1414.4990.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K145`：5G New Radio closed-loop BS test，Order No. `1414.6506.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K148`：5G NR Release 16，Order No. `1414.6664.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K170`：5G NR sidelink，Order No. `1413.8640.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K171`：5G NR Release 17，Order No. `1413.7280.02`。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC；`R&S®SMW-K200` waveform packages 可登錄 1、5 或 50 waveforms，每台 instrument 最多 `250 waveforms`。
- [[R&S Pulse Sequencer]] 相關 options 包含 `R&S®SMW-K300`、`K301`、`K302`、`K304`、`K306`、`K307`、`K308`、`K315`、`K350`。
- Multichannel、MIMO and fading 完整規格另見 `PD 3673.1276.22`；digital standards 完整規格另見 `PD 5213.9434.22`；GNSS/avionics 另見 `PD 3607.6896.22`；Pulse Sequencer 另見 `PD 3607.1388.22`。

R&S FSW › 共通規格條件
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時、warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且若適用已完成 internal automatic adjustments。
- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Operating temperature range：+5 °C to +50 °C。
- Permissible temperature range：0 °C to +55 °C。
- Storage temperature range：–40 °C to +70 °C。
- Display：30.7 cm WXGA color touchscreen，1280 × 800 pixel。
- Internal data storage：standard solid state disk ≥ 128 Gbyte。
- AC input voltage range：100 V to 240 V；AC supply frequency：50 Hz to 60 Hz / 400 Hz。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.7 Transmitter intermodulation
- 目的：評估 transmitter unit 抑制由 wanted signal 與 interfering signal 經由 antenna、RDN、antenna array 到達 transmitter unit 後，在 non-linear elements 中產生 signal 的能力。
- 測試時將 lowest supported channel bandwidth 的 NR signal 作為 interfering signal 注入 antenna connector。
- Interfering signal 的 mean power level 比 wanted signal 的 mean power 低 30 dB。
- Wanted signal：NR signal with NR-FR1-TM1.1。
- Interfering signal：NR signal with NR-FR1-TM1.1，minimum channel bandwidth，15 kHz SCS。
- Interferer level：P rated,t,AC - 30 dB。
- Frequency offset：±0.5 × BW Interferer（n=1）、±1.5 × BW Interferer（n=2）、±2.5 × BW Interferer（n=3）。
- Transmitter intermodulation 的量測條件與 ACLR（6.6.3）、OBUE / SEM（6.6.4）、Transmitter spurious emissions（6.6.5）相同。
- Intermodulation test 中，F1 是 wanted signal，F2 是 interferer。
- SMW manual testing procedure 需要 firmware higher than 4.70.026.51。
- SMW Test Case Wizard（TCW）以 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Rel. 15 為基礎；來源說因 interferer parameter settings 與 Rel. 16 V16.3.0 相同，因此 TCW 可使用。
- Python module `TC_6_7.py` 只包含 interfering generation process。
- 若要執行完整 6.7 Transmitter intermodulation test case，需要執行 `TC_6_7.py`、`TC_6_6_3.py`、`TC_6_6_4.py`、`TC_6_6_5.py`。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.6 Receiver Spurious Emissions
- Spurious emissions power 是 receiver 產生或放大的 emissions 出現在 BS receiver antenna connector 的功率。
- 測試需在 Tx 與 Rx 均開啟時執行，Tx port terminated。
- Receiver spurious emission limits 適用頻率範圍為 30 MHz 到 12.75 GHz；若 UL operating band upper frequency edge 的 5th harmonic 超過 12.75 GHz，範圍會延伸。
- Receiver spurious emission requirements：30 MHz–1 GHz 最大 -57.0 dBm、100 kHz measurement bandwidth；1 GHz–12.75 GHz 最大 -47.0 dBm、1 MHz measurement bandwidth；12.75 GHz–5th harmonic 最大 -47.0 dBm、1 MHz measurement bandwidth。
- Test setup：base station 依 TM1.1 以 rated output power 傳送 NR signal；FSW 透過 Tx notch filter 測量 Rx emissions；Tx 與其他 Rx ports terminated。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.4.1 Adjacent Channel Selectivity
- ACS 衡量 receiver 在相鄰通道 interfering signal 存在時，於 assigned channel frequency 接收 wanted signal 的能力。
- Uplink interfering signal 使用 QPSK modulation。
- Wanted level = [[3GPP TS 38.104]] reference sensitivity level + 6 dB。
- ACS NR interferer levels：Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。
- Interferer 是 DFT-s-OFDM signal，QPSK modulation。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC741`。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

EVM
[[EVM]] 是 Error Vector Magnitude；[[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開，[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 則在 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case 6.4.2.1 中說明 EVM 是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。

EVM › 與 min power 的關係
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.3.1.3-1 定義 minimum power（Pmin）。
- Channel BW 3–20 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 dBm。
- Channel BW 25–100 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 + 10log10(BW/20)。
- 256QAM Test IDs 的 target power 為 **Pmin + 10 dB**。
- 來源另以 100 MHz BW 說明 min power according to Table 6.3.1.3-1 略低於 33 dB；此處照來源摘要保留單位字樣，不自行改寫。

### Chain map
The supported chain is: Wireless Communication requirement → measurable conformance/performance parameter → required Signal Generator and/or Signal Analyzer capability, within 3GPP cellular, NTN, and SAN contexts covered by the passages [100][83][71][79].
| Wireless Communication market / test requirement | Measurable parameter / test item | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| EMC and regulatory testing for wireless devices with 3GPP cellular technology maps to NR base-station RF conformance testing covering Tx, Rx, and performance requirements [100][83]. | Chapter 6 Tx measurements include output power, output power dynamics, transmit ON/OFF power, frequency error, modulation quality, time alignment error, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, SEM, spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation [72]. | Transmitter intermodulation requires an additional signal generator, and the R&S setup lists SMW Base Unit with SMW-K144 for test case 6.7 [72][85]. | The R&S setup lists FSW Base Unit with FSW-K144 for output power, frequency error, modulation quality, time alignment error, ACLR, and SEM, and FSW spectrum analyzer mode for occupied bandwidth and transmitter spurious emissions [85]. |
| 5G NTN-NR extended coverage and NTN-IoT global reach create a need to emulate satellite-channel impairments and weak-link conditions [71]. | NTN testing needs include new fading profiles, atmospheric fading, weather-specific effects, high free-space path loss, low UE-side SNR, minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB, and minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm [19]. | R&S SMW200A channel emulation for NTN testing includes long path delays, enhanced Doppler capabilities, and customized dynamic fading [2]. | NTN component testing uses R&S FSW with frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz, and LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM, and vector signal analysis software [63]. |
| NTN end-to-end system testing requires RF satellite link emulation across UE, NTN payload, service-link channel emulator, and feeder-link channel emulator [16]. | The E2E channel-emulation parameters are update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss [45]. | R&S SMW200A with firmware ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15, and SMW-K820 supports satellite trajectory modeling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [16]. | The cited E2E passages specify signal-generator/channel-emulator capabilities but do not identify a signal-analyzer capability for this E2E chain [16][45]. |
| 5G NR SAN conformance testing targets Satellite Access Node testing linked to 3GPP TS 38.108 and TS 38.181 [79][80]. | SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter characteristics require a spectrum analyzer, while Chapter 7/8 and Chapter 10/11 cover receiver and performance characteristics; SAN TMs/FRCs include output power, radiated transmit power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, OBUE, spurious emissions, EVM, frequency error, receiver sensitivity, and ACS [27][78]. | R&S SMW200A SAN testing features include FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, NR options K144/K148/K171, and B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation [81]. | 5G NR options on R&S FSW / R&S FSVA3000 support SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements [27]. |
| SAN testing needs up to 160 MHz or 200 MHz map to bandwidth, delay, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO [81]. | The supported SAN solution configurations are up to 160 MHz with SMW B10/B14 and up to 200 MHz with SMW B9/B15, both supporting delay requirements and residual Doppler requirements for LEO [81]. | SMW B10/B14 is stated for testing needs up to 160 MHz, and SMW B9/B15 is recommended for testing needs up to 200 MHz [81]. | For the transmitter-measurement side of SAN testing, the supported analyzer role remains FSW / FSVA3000 5G NR options for Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements [27]. |
### Limits
Formal pass/fail limits, measurement uncertainty, test tolerances, instrument options, and software licenses must be checked in the corresponding standards and instrument documents because the cited pages do not provide complete official limits or configurations [6][22][64].

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › fading and path loss
來源指出 satellite connectivity 除 terrestrial fading profiles 外還需要 new fading profiles，包括 atmospheric fading 與 terrestrial fading 的組合，以及 rain、cloud、sun storms causing electron flow 等 weather-specific effects emulation。Large distance 造成 high free space path loss，導致 UE side low SNR。來源列出：

- Minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB。
- Minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm。
- NTN 第一階段目標為 outdoor connections。

來源未提供 3GPP clause、test condition 或 scenario profile，因此只作為測試需求線索。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN IoT device testing requirements › NTN market / ecosystem 線索
來源指出：

- 5G NTN addressable revenue of $35B worldwide by 2035，Source: [[GSMA Intelligence]]。
- NTN-IoT expands global reach for IoT use cases across land、sea、air。
- 5G NTN-NR provides extended coverage that complements terrestrial networks。

這些是 market forecast / presentation claims；未提供完整 GSMA Intelligence report citation、page、model 或 confidence interval。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

3GPP TS 38.141-1 › Chapter 6 conducted transmitter characteristics
來源在 `Tests according to 3GPP TS 38.141-1 v17.5 Chapter 6` 表中列出：

- 6.2 Base station output power。
- 6.3 Output power dynamics。
- 6.4 Transmit ON/OFF power。
- 6.5.2 Transmitted signal quality - Frequency error。
- 6.5.3 Transmitted signal quality - Modulation quality。
- 6.5.4 Transmitted signal quality - Time alignment error。
- 6.6.2 Unwanted emissions - Occupied bandwidth。
- 6.6.3 Unwanted emissions - Adjacent Channel Leakage Power Ratio（ACLR）。
- 6.6.4 Unwanted emissions - Operating band unwanted emissions（SEM）。
- 6.6.5 Unwanted emissions - Transmitter spurious emissions。
- 6.7 Transmitter intermodulation。

來源說其中部分可由 5G NR Option 支援，spurious emissions / occupied bandwidth 等也可由 spectrum analyzer 支援；transmitter intermodulation 需 additional signal generator。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › Test Models 與 FRCs
來源 slide 34 / 35 說 Chapter 6 SAN conducted transmitter characteristics 使用 Test Models（TMs），且 presets already implemented in 5G NR software options K144、K148、K171。表中列出：

- NR-SAN-FR1-TM1.1：SAN output power / radiated transmit power、occupied bandwidth、ACLR、operating band unwanted emissions、transmitter spurious emissions。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM1.2：ACLR、operating band unwanted emissions。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM2：EVM of single 64QAM PRB allocation、frequency error。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.1：total power dynamic range、frequency error、EVM for 64QAM modulation。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.2：frequency error、EVM for 16QAM modulation。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.3：frequency error、EVM for QPSK modulation。

來源 slide 36 說 Chapter 7 receiver characterization and performance measurements 使用 Fixed Reference Channels（FRCs），例如：

- QPSK, R=1/3 G-FR1-A1-1 to G-FR1-A1-9：receiver sensitivity level、ACS 等。
- 16QAM, R=2/3 G-FR1-A2-1 to G-FR1-A2-6：dynamic range。
- QPSK, R=308/1024 G-FR1-A3-1 to G-FR1-A3-6：performance requirements。
- QPSK, R=99/1024 G-FR1-A3A-1、G-FR1-A3A-3。
- Table A.4-1：PRACH test preambles。

5G NR SAN conformance testing
[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025）中針對 [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）的 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] conformance testing 應用；來源將它連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.181]]，並以 [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 signal generator / channel emulator 的核心。

依來源 slide 19 與 slide 32：

| NR SAN RF test methods | [[3GPP TS 38.181]] | specifies RF test methods and conformance requirements for NR SAN type 1-H、SAN type 1-O、SAN type 2-O，以及 NB-IoT operation in NTN NR in-band SAN type 1-H and 1-O。 |
| E-UTRA / NB-IoT SAN | [[3GPP TS 36.108]] | minimum RF characteristics and minimum performance requirements for SAN supporting standalone NB-IoT、E-UTRA 或 NB-IoT operation in NTN NR in-band。 |

5G NR SAN conformance testing › R&S SMW200A key features
依來源 slide 20，[[R&S SMW200A]] 的 SAN testing features 包含：

- FRCs。
- TMs。
- Fading Module。
- AWGN Module。
- static UE propagation models。
- TDL and moving propagation。
